mapper.select: SELECT s.project_id, p.subject_id, s.site_id FROM exam_session s JOIN exam_project p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT status FROM exam_subject WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT id, subject_id FROM exam_project WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT id, status, qualification_status FROM exam_site WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE
SELECT registration_open FROM exam_project_site WHERE project_id = #{project} AND site_id = #{site} FOR SHARE
SELECT id, project_id, site_id, registration_starts_at, registration_ends_at, capacity, registered_count, status, ticket_published_at, score_published_at FROM exam_session WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_session SET registered_count = registered_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND registered_count < capacity AND registration_starts_at <= #{now} AND registration_ends_at > #{now} AND ticket_published_at IS NULL AND score_published_at IS NULL
